## Problem

What problem does this solve? Who is affected?

## Proposal

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you weigh? Why is this one better?

## Out of scope

What does this *not* do?

## Mockups / references

If you have sketches, screenshots, or links to similar features, drop them here.

## Cost

A rough sense of effort (hours / days / weeks).
